title: Southwind Village

'''Southwind Village''' was once a [[night elven]] base of operation in [[Silithus]], but was destroyed by the [[qiraji]] during the [[War of the Shifting Sands]]. [[Valstann Staghelm]], son of [[Fandral Staghelm]], led a detatchment of the night elven army to defend the [[village]], but was captured by [[General Rajaxx]] after his troops were slaughtered by the swarming qiraji. Today, Southwind Village has been long since overrun by relentless [[silithid]] that infest large parts of that area. The horror of the village's initial sundering still echos through time — the tortured spirits of fallen [[Tortured Druid|druid]]s and [[Tortured Sentinel|Sentinel]]s wander the ruins aimlessly, and are led by [[Shade of Ambermoon]].
